title.narrative: AfricaConnect 3 - Cluster 1 (Eastern and Southern Africa)

description.narrative: AfricaConnect 3 will contribute to enhance human capital development in Africa (Overall Objective). More specifically, it will seek to unlock the potential of education and research through increased access of African education and research institutions to digital infrastructures and technologies (Specific Objective). This contract will cover the activities in Eastern and Southern Africa (Cluster 1 of the project)

Therefore the numbers for 2025 wil be a lot lower then for the rest of the years. Thus we only report on an accumulative target.
